regions.today: A hot and humid day with long sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 27 to 30 degrees, with light or moderate east to southeast winds.
regions.tonight: Warm and muggy tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Some showers will develop overnight, possibly turning heavy and thundery. Lowest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees with mainly light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Staying warm and humid tomorrow, Friday, with sunny spells and showers. Some of the showers may be heavy and thundery, with a chance of localised flooding, Cloud, mist and fog will develop in southern coastal areas from late morning. Highest temperatures of 24 to 29 degrees, but a few degrees cooler in coastal parts of the south. Light and variable winds will become mostly moderate southerly by evening.
regions.solar_uv: High or very high on Thursday, Moderate to high on Friday.
